privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy & disclaimer
privacyPolicy.lead: Your records and health information should always be clear to you.
privacyPolicy.contact: Questions about this policy or personal data? Contact us through Profile → Feedback & help.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.content: To provide the service, we process your WeChat sign-in identifier, nickname and avatar that you choose to set, body and nutrition-goal profile, food logs, meal images you choose to upload for recognition, and feedback you submit.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.content: This information is used only to identify accounts and isolate data, show logs and goal progress, estimate meal nutrition, provide image recognition and nutrition-coach suggestions, and respond to your questions and feedback.

sections.title: Automated processing and permissions
sections.content: When you choose a meal image, it is used to identify foods and estimate nutrition. Camera and photo-library access are used only to select meal images or save a share poster you request. Your nickname and avatar are used only when you authorize or edit them.

sections.title: Storage and retention
sections.content: Data is written to CloudBase over an HTTPS-encrypted connection and retained while your Nordic Nutri AI product account exists. After successful account deletion, product profile, body and goal data, food logs, recognition images, and related data are deleted.

sections.title: Your choices and rights
sections.content: You can edit your nickname, avatar, body profile, and goals on your profile page; sign out from this device; or request deletion of your Nordic Nutri AI product account. Deleting the product account does not delete or affect your WeChat account.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.content: Food recognition, nutrition estimates, and coach suggestions are for everyday dietary reference only. They are not medical diagnosis, treatment, or prescriptions, and do not replace advice from a doctor, registered dietitian, or other professional. Consult a professional about health concerns.
